text:
julie: I pushed a draft relnotes PR for the docs site covering the routing policy tweak, embeddings streaming removal, and a short FAQ for Dedicated autoscale. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510. Need a short compatibility note for enterprise customers and a quick sweep of SDK snippets.

omar: Nice. Two quick asks: can we add a one-line backcompat callout for customers pinning model names (legacy model IDs may 404 when we promote variants)? Also, update the Ruby and PHP snippets if they're present.

ke: Found a small inconsistency in the JS examples: new client uses `stream_mode: 'chunks'` instead of `streaming`. Should we standardize on `stream_mode` in all examples and add a tiny migration note?

julie: Good catch. I'll update the JS examples to use `stream_mode`. Let's include a side note: "If you're on a pre-1.2 client, continue using `streaming: true`." Keeps things clear.

frank: I ran the automated link-checker on the branch and got 3 failing anchors: `/guides/cache#prefix` -> should be `/reference/kv-cache`, `/docs/embeds#live-stream` -> `/reference/embeddings#migration`, and an internal KB link that needs an ID update. I'll push a redirects commit to the branch.

release-bot: link-checker report: 3 broken anchors, 1 internal stale link. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/linkcheck/4510

omar: For the release note blurb about routing, propose: "Hosted default routing now favors low latency; teams can opt into cost-first routing per-route via the `routing_policy` config. See migration examples." Suggest adding a YAML snippet showing the opt-out.

julie: Yup. I'll add that YAML and a short example showing fallback to cost-variant. Example YAML I plan to add:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  priority: latency
  fallback: cost_variant
```

ke: Quick SDK checklist in the PR description would help reviewers. I can take JS + Node, Omar can take Ruby + PHP, Frank can sign off on link fixes and deploy preview. I'll update the checklist: [ ] js, [ ] ruby, [ ] php, [x] redirects pending, [x] known issues draft.

omar: Starting Ruby/PH P snippets now. Note for Ruby: client init renamed last month from `Ruby::Client.new` -> `Redwood.connect`. I'll include both variants. For PHP we need to switch `createEmbedding` -> `embed` in alpha, will show both.

frank: Pushed redirect commit and fixed the internal KB identifier. Re-ran link-checker: link-checker now green for anchors. Also triggered deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4510--docs.redwood.ai/ (expires in 7 days).

release-bot: deploy preview ready: https://deploy-preview-4510--docs.redwood.ai/

julie: Thanks. Omar/Ke, please paste your snippet commits into the PR before 14:30 PT so I can merge and tag the relnotes for the site release. If we miss that, we'll schedule the release for the next maintenance window.

ke: Pushed JS updates: replaced `streaming` with `stream_mode: 'chunks'` and added a brief migration note. Snippet diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510/files#diff-... Marked JS done.

omar: Ruby and PHP snippets pushed. Included backcompat examples and noted preferred client versions. Also added a small wording tweak to the relnotes intro to call out potential eval reruns for quantization recommendations.

frank: Visual QA pass on the preview looks OK. A small table overflow in mobile view on the embeddings migration page; I added a CSS tweak commit to constrain column width. Re-running preview.

release-bot: visual preview check: 1 mobile layout warning (pending fix).

julie: Thanks everyone. If the mobile warning clears in the next CI run I'll merge and post the announce blurb. If not, hold until the fix lands. Will draft the announce blurb once merged.

ke: Draft blurb suggestion: "Docs update: routing defaults, embeddings migration guide, and updated SDK snippets for smoother upgrades. Read the migration guide before upgrading your client." Shorter: "Docs: migration guide + SDK updates for embeddings and routing."

omar: +1. I'll help craft the customer-facing note for enterprise support teams after the merge.

julie: Great. Merge target: today 15:00 PT if CI green.
